A Look at the Wider Divide in Credit Card Delinquency by Income
posts.text: Credit card delinquency rose sharply between 2022 and 2024, and the increase was steepest among borrowers in lower-income neighborhoods. Here, we check in on credit card performance by neighborhood income and trace when the borrowers who are now struggling with their payments were issued cards. We find that during the pandemic, an increasing share of new credit cards went to borrowers with lower incomes and credit scores, and those accounts are now showing higher levels of distress.

posts.head: US Jobs Report Competes with the Unsettled Equity Market to Drive the Greenback
posts.text: The US dollar is broadly stronger. Against many G10 pairs, it is at its best level since Tuesday’s midterm elections.
